purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Toraghundi

queries.query: Toraghundi Afghanistan cadastral parcel map official land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ministry of Urban Development and Housing (MUDL/MUDH) as the relevant land/GIS custodian, including an official Toraghundi survey notice and a Toraghundi-specific ownership-verification notice. The Ministry of Justice PRMIS/PMS property-registration application was also identified, but no public cadastral parcel map was found.

queries.query: تورغندی افغانستان کادستر نقشه زمین اداره اراضی / اداره اراضی افغانستان نقشه کادستر تورغندی
queries.result: Dari/Pashto first-party discovery found MUDL notices stating that 804 jerib in the Toraghundi border area was surveyed and that ownership verification along the TAPI route reached the Toraghundi market area. The notices evidence local surveying/land-administration activity, not an openly queryable parcel layer or native parcel identifiers.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ministry of Urban Development and Housing / land and GIS directorates; Ministry of Justice PRMIS/PMS is a separate property-registration application.
registryEvidence.locality: Toraghundi, Ribat-e-Sangi district, Herat province (as described by the MUDL notices).
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The notices evidence surveying and ownership-verification work in parts of Toraghundi/Herat, but no public local registry/cadastre viewer, parcel schema, or citywide coverage was independently verified. registryFound therefore remains null.

parcelDiscovery.source: No public parcel geometry source verified; MUDL/MUDH land/GIS notices and Ministry of Justice PRMIS/PMS were reviewed.

officialSources.observation: Official MUDL notice reports a technical survey of 804 jerib in the Toraghundi border area.
Official MUDL notice reports ownership verification along the TAPI route from the Turkmenistan border toward the Toraghundi market and describes the route parcels as state land.
Official Ministry of Justice PRMIS/PMS landing page identifies a Property Registration Management Information System; it is not an open parcel-map viewer.
Official MUDL programme page describes land administration GIS/basic-map infrastructure, but no public parcel endpoint was exposed in this attempt.
